title: The Loyalty Test
logline: A paranoid merchant hires a pilot to stage a fake assassination attempt to test their bodyguard's loyalty, but it goes disastrously wrong.

roles.description: Jumpy, constantly drinking, trusts no one.
Silent, professional, incredibly exhausted by their boss.
A ludicrously expensive orbital spa surrounded by automated turrets.
A cheap, rented fighter painted aggressively red.
The ruthless corporate entity the boss works for.

public_situation: The {role:paranoid_boss} has locked themselves inside their {role:private_resort}, convinced the {role:merchant_guild} is trying to kill them.
private_truth: The boss is completely fine, but they are terrified their bodyguard will betray them, so they hired an actor to stage a fake attack.

beats.public_change: The resort's defense grid is taken offline for "routine maintenance".

missions.reason: The boss asks the pilot to deliver ferrite to "patch the hull", secretly using it as an excuse to get the pilot past the bodyguard.
missions.private_fact: The boss slips the pilot a massive bag of credits and a script for the fake attack.

beats.public_change: The fake assassin jumps into the system and begins broadcasting threatening messages.

missions.reason: The boss asks the pilot to meet a corrupt quartermaster at the armory loading dock and collect all the live ammunition, replacing it with blanks.
missions.private_fact: The bodyguard catches the pilot in the armory, but just sighs and lets them go, assuming it's another one of the boss's stupid tests.

beats.public_change: The fake assassin begins their attack run, firing blank torpedoes at the resort.

missions.reason: The boss begs the pilot to attack the decoy assassin, pretending they are saving the day to make the test look real.
missions.private_fact: The bodyguard hails the pilot, revealing they actually got hired by the guild to kill the boss today, and offers the pilot half the bounty to help them.

resolutions.summary: The fake attack is thwarted. The boss embraces the bodyguard, completely unaware they were actually about to be murdered. The pilot is paid well.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped stage a fake assassination to calm a paranoid merchant.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the bodyguard's offer.
resolutions.summary: The pilot helps the bodyguard murder the boss. The bodyguard claims the bounty, and the pilot gets a cut. The guild is satisfied.
The fake attack fizzles out. In the confusion, the bodyguard quietly snaps the boss's neck and blames it on the assassin.

loose_threads.detail: The guild's bounty on the boss wasn't for treason; it was because the boss accidentally discovered a massive accounting error.
The bodyguard mutters that this isn't even the first time they've had to murder a paranoid boss for the guild.

radio_hooks: Bizarre incident at {role:private_resort} leaves authorities confused.
{role:merchant_guild} refuses to comment on alleged assassination attempt.

voice_direction.paranoid_boss: Fast, frantic, constantly dropping their voice to a hush.
voice_direction.loyal_bodyguard: Deep, tired, speaks as little as possible.
